Recipe.Name: Carrot Egg Fried Rice
Recipe.Desc: A streamlined, high-efficiency stir-fry that transforms leftover rice, carrots, and eggs into a complete, nutritious meal in under 10 minutes. Perfect for using up odds and ends.
Recipe.Steps: 1. Scramble the eggs in a hot wok with a little oil, then set aside. 2. Finely dice the carrots (uniform 1/4-inch cubes for optimal heat transfer). 3. In the same wok, sauté the carrots until just tender-crisp. 4. Add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 2 minutes. 5. Return the scrambled eggs to the wok, toss to combine, and season with salt, pepper, and a splash of soy sauce if available.
